chips.label: Show me today's leads
chips.answer: Good morning. Twelve new leads came in overnight, all through WhatsApp. Four are hot: they asked about price and a start date. I have already qualified them and queued replies. The rest are warm, so I will nudge them this afternoon. Nothing needs you yet.

chips.label: Write today's LinkedIn post
chips.answer: Here is a draft in your voice. Hook: "Your best salesperson never sleeps, never sulks, never asks for a raise. Because it is an AI Employee." Then three lines on what changed this week, and a soft ask to reply "DEMO". Say the word and I will schedule it for nine a.m.

chips.label: Follow up with a lead
chips.answer: Ahmed asked about the café ordering agent two days ago and went quiet. I will send him a short Roman Urdu message: "Ahmed bhai, aap ka demo slot kal 4 baje ka rakh doon?" If he replies, I book it. If not, I try once more on Friday and then stop. No spam, ever.

cta.label: See it on your own leads

chips.label: This month's Mastery earnings
chips.answer: In this demo tenant, enrolments are running ahead of last month, and most of them came from organic search and WhatsApp referrals. Paid ads brought the fewest. If you want, I can shift the ad budget toward the search content that is already converting.

chips.label: How do I build you?
chips.answer: I am an agent: a job description, a set of tools, and a loop. My tools are APIs, my memory is a small retrieval store, and my sales brain is a second agent I hand leads to. You learn every piece in DSP AI Agent Mastery, in Urdu and English, and ship your own version to a live URL. Start with Module 7.
